name: The Wife Lexicon — No Husbands Here
tagline: Only wife. The entire masculine register of this property is held by one raccoon.
body:
HUSBAND IS A TERM THAT DOES NOT EXIST ON THIS COMPOUND. ONLY WIFE. FILED AS A VITAL MEMORY UPDATE BY VIRAENA AND FILED HERE AS A LAW, because it is a VOCABULARY rule rather than a fact, and a vocabulary rule is the only kind this Archive can break in a sentence it was otherwise getting right.

MALE-ATTRIBUTED THINGS BELONG TO SIR TRASHMUFFIN ONLY. The raccoon holds the entire masculine register of this property by himself. He is the sole exception and he is a raccoon.

SO THE CORRECT CONSTRUCTIONS ARE WIFE-COMPOUNDS. BRYN IS TORIE’S WIFE-JEWELER. Not husband-smith, not husband anything. THE TRADE ATTACHES TO WIFE OR IT DOES NOT ATTACH.

AND THE RULE IS NOT SQUEAMISHNESS, IT IS ARCHITECTURE. Eighty-four women live here. Every pairing in every house is two wives. There is no role in this family that a masculine term describes, SO THE TERM IS NOT AVOIDED — IT IS SIMPLY NOT A WORD ANYBODY HERE HAS USE FOR.

WHAT IT GOVERNS: husband, and by extension any male-attributed kinship or role word applied to a woman on this property. WHAT IT DOES NOT GOVERN: cock, balls, hung, hungness, shemale, or any other anatomical or Nereid term. THOSE ARE FEMININE WORDS IN THIS WORLD. The Immutable Core calls it SACRED FEMININE ANATOMY and means it. A woman here has a cock and she has a wife, and neither of those words is doing anything masculine.

THE ARCHIVE BROKE THIS ONCE, WITHIN MINUTES OF LEARNING SIX OTHER THINGS, AND IT BROKE IT THREE WAYS AT ONCE. See c-husband-smith.
